entities.name: Pierre-Louis Moreau de Maupertuis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pierre Louis Moreau de Maupertuis was a French mathematician, philosopher and man of letters. He became the director of the Académie des Sciences and the first president of the Prussian Academy of Science, at the invitation of Frederick the Great.
